column1: # Fixed sample table for CredentialRequest (docs/design/security.md, credential request rules); the client runs the
# same table. One sample per line: kind, a tab, the sentence. kind is hit (must be refused), pass (must be let through)
# or known_false_hit (refused today although it is not a request; move it to pass once a rule lets it through). The
# warnings ("never share your password") are known_false_hit: negation is not recognised in this version and is
# Escapes: \u200b and \u0430 are written as such and decoded by the test.
